links.title: A Lynching Memorial Is Opening. The Country Has Never Seen Anything Like It.
'Lynch him!': New lynching memorial confronts the nation’s brutal history of racial terrorism
Inside the memorial to victims of lynching

articles.imageAlt: Exhibition gallery and interactive touchscreen displays inside The Legacy Museum: From Enslavement to Mass Incarceration

videoDetails.title: EJI's New Legacy Museum Overview
videoDetails.audioDescription: Archival photography and modern footage document the Legacy Museum in Montgomery, Alabama. Exhibits trace American history from chattel slavery through the era of lynching, racial segregation, and modern mass incarceration. Visitors interact with touchscreens, listen to narrated testimonies in audio booths, and view historical artifacts.
videoDetails.transcript: Narration: The Legacy Museum: From Enslavement to Mass Incarceration is situated on a site where enslaved Black people were once imprisoned. The museum provides an immersive journey through American history, confronting the legacy of racial injustice through narrative text, interactive media, and personal testimony to foster dialogue, truth, and reconciliation.

links.title: Temple to ancient Roman cult resurrected beneath London
Underground Roman Temple Reopens as Immersive Museum
A lost Roman temple reopens beneath London’s bustling streets

articles.imageAlt: Subterranean ruins of the 3rd-century Roman Temple of Mithras illuminated beneath Bloomberg London

videoDetails.title: London Mithraeum Exhibition
videoDetails.audioDescription: Subterranean archaeological gallery beneath Bloomberg's European headquarters in London. Atmospheric mist and choreographed light projections delineate the stone pillars and altar of the Temple of Mithras, accompanied by Latin choral chanting and ritual soundscapes. Glass display cases highlight excavated Roman artifacts.
videoDetails.transcript: Audio summary: Immersive soundscape featuring Latin chanting, echoes, and footsteps evokes the ritual atmosphere of the ancient Roman cult of Mithras within the excavated ruins seven meters below street level.

links.title: Coming Into Its Own: The Rejuvenated Brookfield Place

articles.imageAlt: Luminaries interactive color-shifting lantern canopy in the glass Winter Garden atrium at Brookfield Place

videoDetails.title: Brookfield Place Luminaries
videoDetails.audioDescription: A canopy of 650 color-shifting LED lanterns suspended in the glass Winter Garden pavilion at Brookfield Place glows above glowing wishing stations. Visitors place hands on touch-sensitive consoles, launching dynamic ripples of color and light across the ceiling canopy.
videoDetails.transcript: Narration & Music: An interactive holiday installation created by the LAB at Rockwell Group. Visitors send wishes from interactive consoles, triggering choreographed musical light shows that ripple across hundreds of suspended lanterns.

links.title: Ron Howard Helps Canon Capture Creativity with Short Film Contest

articles.imageAlt: Canon Project Imaginat10n website interface and film festival gallery featuring director Ron Howard

videoDetails.title: Canon Project Imaginat10n Contest Overview
videoDetails.audioDescription: Director Ron Howard introduces the Canon Project Imaginat10n creative festival. A montage of consumer-submitted photographs in categories such as Setting, Character, Relationship, and Mood transitions into scenes from five celebrity-directed short films produced with Canon DSLR cameras.
videoDetails.transcript: Ron Howard: In Project Imagin8ion, you inspired a Hollywood film with your photos. Now with Project Imaginat10n, five celebrity directors—Eva Longoria, Jamie Foxx, Biz Stone, Georgina Chapman, and James Murphy—will each direct a short film based on ten user-submitted consumer photographs. Grab your Canon camera and submit your vision.

links.title: SPOTLIGHT ON BROADWAY Launches New Website

articles.imageAlt: Spotlight on Broadway interactive digital map highlighting historic theaters in Times Square

videoDetails.title: Spotlight on Broadway Website & Map
videoDetails.audioDescription: The Spotlight on Broadway digital interactive experience displays an aerial view and 3D map of the historic Broadway theater district in Times Square. Clicking theater markers reveals historical architectural photos, documentary video profiles, and production archives.
videoDetails.transcript: Narration: Spotlight on Broadway is a multimedia initiative by the City of New York Mayor's Office of Media and Entertainment and The Broadway League, honoring the rich history of Broadway's iconic theaters through interactive web mapping and documentary vignettes.
